keyword_popups.text: ลงน้ำหนักให้ถูกต้อง
กดส้นเท้าลงพื้น
ใช้ส้นเท้าและก้น

edit_note: Three popups target the core technique cues: proper weight distribution (10s), pressing the heel flat to the floor (28s), and the payoff—training the body to load heel and glutes instead of the knee (37s).

cleanup.notes: Primary error types: (1) repeated tone-mark drop on ย่อลง→ยอดลง across two segments; (2) one classic sound-alike consonant swap ป→บ producing บ่ายเจ็บ instead of ปวดเจ็บ; (3) one vowel tone-mark error เสื่อ→เสือ turning 'mat' into 'tiger'; (4) a spurious ล appended to พอ in two consecutive segments, likely a boundary artifact from the ASR decoder.

corrections.reason: fitness context — 'ย่อลง' (lower the body) fits a step-up/lunge cue; 'ยอดลง' (peak descends) is not a fitness phrase. Missing mai ek tone mark on ย่อ.

corrections.corrected: ฟังก์ชันนัล
corrections.reason: English loan word 'functional' transcribed without the ก์ consonant cluster; ฟังก์ชันนัล is the standard Thai spelling of this term.
fitness context — 'ปวดเจ็บ' (pain/soreness) is the expected phrase; 'บ่าย' (afternoon) is a sound-alike consonant substitution (ป→บ).
tone mark error — 'เสื่อ' (mat, e.g. a folding foam mat) fits the context of 'พับได้' (foldable); 'เสือ' (tiger) makes no sense in a fitness equipment reference.
spurious ล — 'แถมพอวางเข่า' (and when placing the knee down) is a natural Thai connective phrase; 'พอล' is not a word here and the ล appears to be a STT insertion artifact.
same spurious ล as index 7 — segment is a continuation of the same clause; 'พอวางเข่า' (when the knee is placed) is the correct phrase.
identical error to index 0 — 'ย่อลง' (lower down) is the correct fitness cue describing the descent phase of the movement.
